 EDUCATION

Engineering Aggregate: 56.87%

 TECHNICAL SKILLS	

Tools & Technologies: SQL, Jira, Aha!, Balsamiq, SharePoint, Microsoft Excel (Advanced), Microsoft Word, Microsoft PowerPoint.

 CORE COMPETENCIES	

Enterprise Business Analysis

Requirements Elicitation & Functional Specifications

Solution Design & Process Optimization

Product Backlog Management & Value-Based Prioritization

Agile Scrum & Release Planning

Treasury Management Systems (TMS)

Treasury Operations & Risk Management Platforms

Straight-Through Processing (STP) Enablement

Exception Handling & Workflow Design

OTC Derivatives Regulatory Reporting

Regulatory Change Impact Assessment

Scaled Agile Program Delivery

User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Strategy & Business Sign-Off

Cross-Functional Stakeholder & Client Management

Multi-Team Collaboration, Governance & Knowledge Management

 JOB OBJECTIVE	

Dynamic and results-driven Business Systems Analyst with a robust focus on treasury and risk management, targeting to leverage extensive experience in regulatory reporting and product ownership within the banking and finance sectors.

 PROFILE SUMMARY	

Business Analysis & Product Leadership: Gained over 15 years of progressive IT experience, including 9 years in Business Analysis and Product Ownership roles and 6 years in manual and automation testing, delivering business-critical solutions across treasury, risk, and regulatory technology domains.

Treasury & Risk Management Expertise: Possess deep domain expertise across Treasury Management Systems (TMS), Corporate Treasury, Risk Management, OTC Derivatives, Liquidity Management, Cash Forecasting, In-House Banking, Multilateral Netting, STP, CLS, and Trade Lifecycle Management, enabling effective alignment of technology solutions with business objectives.

Global Regulatory Reporting SME: Established as a trusted subject matter expert for OTC Derivatives Regulatory Reporting, driving compliance and reporting transformation initiatives across EMIR, FCA, CFTC, ESMA, ISO 20022 MX Formats, Collateral Reporting, and Valuation Reporting frameworks.

Strategic Product Ownership & Roadmap Execution: Directed product backlog governance, requirements prioritization, and roadmap execution, enhancing delivery predictability and stakeholder satisfaction through value-driven Agile planning and execution.

Large-Scale Regulatory Transformation Leadership: Successfully led the delivery of EMIR and FCA REFIT programs, orchestrating cross-functional teams and enabling the seamless migration and go-live of 40+ global clients while maintaining 100% regulatory compliance within mandated timelines.

Innovation & Platform Modernization: Spearheaded the development of a configuration-driven, no-code integration and packaging framework, reducing deployment effort, accelerating implementation timelines, and enhancing solution scalability across enterprise environments.

Stakeholder Engagement & Enterprise Collaboration: Built strong partnerships across Treasury, Risk, Compliance, Product Management, Engineering, QA, Architecture, and Client organizations, translating complex regulatory and business requirements into high-impact enterprise solutions.

Operational Excellence & Process Optimization: Championed workflow automation, approval process modernization, exception handling improvements, and process standardization initiatives, driving enhanced governance, operational efficiency, and user adoption across multiple product modules.

Agile Delivery & Business Impact: Showcased leadership in Scaled Agile environments by managing multi-team programs, release planning, UAT governance, and business sign-offs, consistently delivering high-quality solutions that improved customer experience, reduced operational risk, and strengthened regulatory readiness.

 WORK EXPERIENCE	

FIS Global | Senior Business Systems Analyst/ Product Owner | Aug 2017 – Present

Established as the global SME for OTC derivatives regulatory reporting, driving compliance initiatives across EMIR, FCA, CFTC, and ASIC regulatory frameworks.

Led end-to-end functional analysis and delivery of regulatory reporting and treasury transformation programs in collaboration with Product, Development, and QA teams.

Spearheaded analysis and implementation of EMIR/FCA REFIT requirements, engaging with the industry bodies and trade repositories to align product capabilities with evolving regulations.

Directed successful onboarding and go-live execution for 40+ clients under EMIR and FCA REFIT programs through cross-functional stakeholder coordination.

Enhanced enterprise workflow and approval frameworks by introducing scalable, configuration-driven maker-checker controls supporting up to 99 approval stages.

Delivered no-code, version-agnostic integration capabilities through reusable workflow orchestration solutions, reducing deployment effort and implementation timelines.

Designed reusable packaging and deployment frameworks that accelerated solution roll-out and improved operational efficiency across implementations.

Delivered enterprise-scale capabilities spanning regulatory reporting, payments enablement, workflow automation, and governance controls.

Worked as Acting Product Owner, leading backlog prioritization, release planning, and delivery across three concurrent Agile teams, ensuring timely execution of strategic initiatives.

FIS Global | Quality Analyst | May 2014 – Aug 2017

Strengthened product quality and regulatory compliance by leading testing initiatives for treasury and OTC derivatives lifecycle management solutions.

Improved regression testing effectiveness through automation enhancements and optimized test execution strategies.

Led enterprise-wide compatibility testing of FIS Quantum against Microsoft security updates, safeguarding platform stability across 5,000+ hosted servers and reducing production risk.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration testing, defect resolution, and release readiness for mission-critical financial platforms.

Aloha Technology | Quality Analyst | Dec 2010 – Jan 2014

Drove end-to-end quality assurance, requirements validation, and test execution for enterprise applications, ensuring successful project delivery.

Led client demonstrations, sprint planning activities, and stakeholder interactions to improve delivery transparency and customer satisfaction.

Owned test strategy development, execution management, and defect governance, contributing to consistent product quality and on-time releases.

 ACHIEVEMENTS	

Recipient of the Above and Beyond Award for outstanding contributions and delivery excellence.

Recognized with multiple Excellence Awards for consistently high performance and business impact.

Awarded Employee of the Month on multiple occasions for exceptional commitment and results.

Finalist – Innovate in 48, a company-wide innovation challenge recognizing high-impact ideas and solutions.

 PROJECTS	

Quantum Treasury & Risk Management: Delivered solutions for cash and liquidity management, debt administration, investments, and financial risk management.

Derivative Reporting Solution: Enabled regulatory reporting of OTC derivative trade lifecycles in ISO 20022-compliant formats across multiple jurisdictions.

Data Loader Framework: Designed and enhanced integration capabilities for ingesting deal data from multiple trading platforms and master data from ERP systems into Treasury Management Systems (TMS), enabling standardized processing and automation.

Multilateral Netting Engine: Supported optimization of cross-border payment flows through automated netting capabilities, reducing transaction volumes and operational costs.

Advanced Approval Framework: Expanded approval workflow from a standard two-level maker-checker process to a scalable framework supporting up to 99 configurable approval levels.

API Payments Enablement: Enhanced EFT processing and payment automation through API-driven payment initiation and configuration capabilities.

Workflow Management Module: Delivered a configurable workflow framework enabling flexible business process orchestration and automation.
